Terms

These terms are an agreement between you and Mustafa AlHassan for the use of the app and this website. Please read them with the privacy page.

What the app is

A free companion for reading and reflection. It shows verses of the Quran with their source, reasoning written with AI, and passages from other scriptures with their book and verse number. It asks questions for you to think about and records nothing. It is not a substitute for a teacher, a scholar, a counsellor or a doctor, and it issues no religious rulings.

Free, with no account

The app and the website are free. There is no account, no subscription and no purchase. There are no ads.

Your words

The app asks you to write nothing. Anything you choose to send us is used only to improve the app.

The texts

The Quran text is the Tanzil Uthmani text, shown unchanged under its licence. Other texts are shown under the licences named on the sources page. You may quote and share pages of this site with their source. You may not present any text from the site as your own or alter a sacred text and present it as the app's.

Reading with care

The reasoning in the app is our reading, written with AI. It can be wrong. Please check anything that matters to you with someone you trust. If you find an error in a text, please tell us; the support page explains how.

Acceptable use

Do not use the site to break the law, to attack any person or community, or to probe or overload the service.

No warranty and liability

The app and the website are provided as they are. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for loss arising from their use. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
